title: Gameweek 6 Hall of Shame: the blanks, the cameos, and the captain who cost you
dek: The awards nobody wants from Gameweek 6, starting with B.Fernandes. Every one of them a real number, which is the problem.
body:
## The awards nobody wants

The serious write-up of Gameweek 6 is elsewhere on this desk. This is the other one: the same numbers, read for entertainment rather than instruction.

Every award below is a real lookup against the round's data. Nothing here is invented, which is the part that stings.

:::takeaways
- **B.Fernandes** takes the Golden Blank at £11.9m.
- The field captained **Haaland** for 6 points.
- **Henderson** scored 18 at 0.3% ownership.
:::

###  The Golden Blank

**B.Fernandes** cost £11.9m and returned 1 point from 90 minutes at home to TOT. 35% of managers watched all of it.

###  The Armband Tax

**Haaland** was the popular armband and returned 6 points, which the armband turned into 12. A rare week where the crowd and the scoreboard agreed.

###  The One You Did Not Own

**Henderson** (£4.9m) scored 18 while owned by 0.3% of managers. The other 99.7% are currently explaining to themselves that they would never have started him, which is true, and beside the point.

###  Cameo of the Week

2 minutes. 7 points. **Hadjam** did more after coming on than several people did all afternoon, most of them in your starting eleven.

###  Best Value on the Board

**Henderson** at £4.9m returned 18 — 3.7 points per million. Premium ownership is a lifestyle choice and this is the invoice.

###  Mugged by the Woodwork

**Delap** generated 1.07 expected goal involvements and converted precisely none of them. The underlying numbers liked him a great deal more than the scoreboard did, which is either a buy signal or a warning depending on how your season is going.

## For the record

The average manager scored **58**, the best score in the game was **131**, and the gap between them was 73 points — roughly a captain, a bench and a small amount of luck.

:::callout insight
The useful version of this gameweek is in the Debrief. This one was for morale.
:::
